detector.method: PCA normal-behaviour model per case: 10-minute averages, fitted on the case's normal training rows, 95% of variance kept; alarm when reconstruction error exceeds the 99% percentile of held-out normal rows; event detected when the benchmark's criticality counter reaches 72.

reference.note: Gück et al. 2024 (arXiv 2404.10320v2), all 95 cases; scores can vary on reproduction

detector.sensitivity_note: scored on the same labels, so it shows how much the settings matter, not a tuned result
